note: Cook's units the cart cannot buy by weight — cans, cloves, bunches, sprigs. Each must survive as the word the line used, with the count in measure, so the editor shows what the cook wrote and the cart still gets a number.

source.title: Store Cupboard Three Bean Chilli
source.text:
Serves 6 generously.

2 cans kidney beans, drained
1 can black beans, drained
1 can chopped tomatoes
4 cloves garlic, crushed
1 bunch spring onions, sliced
2 sprigs thyme
1 tablespoon smoked paprika
2 teaspoons ground cumin
500 ml vegetable stock

Everything in one pot. Simmer 30 minutes. Better the next day.
